items.title: Surge Engine 1.0.0 – Complete Feature Overview
items.body: automation tools to advanced Roblox customisation. Here's a complete breakdown of every feature.

changes.text: Dashboard: Fully customisable auto clicker with support for any keyboard key or mouse button as an activation key, including Middle Mouse, Mouse 4, Mouse 5 and modifier combinations (Ctrl, Alt, Shift and Win).
Dashboard: Hold and Toggle activation modes. Hold clicks while the activation key is held, while Toggle starts and stops clicking with each press.
Dashboard: Choose between Left, Middle and Right Mouse Button for automated clicks.
Dashboard: Adjustable click speed from 0.1 to 500 CPS, or Unlimited, with customisable duty cycle and live click/wait timing information.
Dashboard: Custom click limit to automatically stop after a specified number of clicks.
Dashboard: Choose between clicking at your cursor or at a captured fixed screen position, using a 3-second countdown.
Dashboard: App targeting lets you restrict clicking to selected programs when they are in the foreground.
Dashboard: Live click counter and READY / CLICKING status indicator.
Dashboard: Right Now card displaying the Roblox game you're currently playing.
Dashboard: Windows autostart, Always on Top, settings reset and automatic settings saving.
Dashboard: Multilingual interface supporting English, German and Spanish.
Dashboard: High-precision click timing for smooth, consistent performance.
Dashboard: Interactive guided tour explaining the main features, available to replay anytime.
Profile: Discord profile card with an optional Discord status display.
Profile: Nine built-in themes: Default Black, Surge Official, Floating Stars, Snowfall, Embers, Rain, Solo Leveling x Qc1m, Sasuke Sunset and Frosted Glass.
Profile: Import custom images, GIFs or videos as themes, with optional looping background music and adjustable volume.
Profile: Custom accent colours and an option to keep theme animations running when the window is unfocused.
Profile: Streamproof mode hides the application from supported screen-sharing, streaming and recording captures, with a global hotkey to toggle it.
Profile: Quick access to your settings folder.
Roblox: FPS unlocker with quick toggles for low-resolution textures, shadows, post-processing, anti-aliasing and renderer settings.
Roblox: Built-in FFlag editor with a one-click option to reset Fast Flags.
Roblox: Custom font support. Import your own fonts, open the fonts folder and restore the original font whenever needed.
Roblox: Launch Roblox directly through Surge Engine using a Game ID or standard launch option. Includes quick access to the Roblox folder and tools to clear cache and logs.
Movement: Snappy Tappy gives priority to the most recently pressed key when holding opposing movement keys, with independent Left / Right and Forward / Back controls.
Movement: Fully rebindable movement keys. Change bindings by selecting a key slot or clicking a key on the interactive on-screen keyboard.
Clips: Instant Replay continuously keeps your latest gameplay moments ready to save with a customisable hotkey.
Clips: Manual gameplay recording with a dedicated hotkey and configurable PC audio and microphone settings.
Clips: Recording overlays including webcam support with mirror mode, keyboard overlay, mouse overlay and a microphone indicator that lights up while speaking.
Clips: Built-in clip library with video previews, storage settings and an integrated FFmpeg downloader.
Utilities: Screen customisation tools for software brightness, gamma and colour warmth. Supports individual or all monitors, automatic restoration on exit and applying settings on startup.
Utilities: Internet optimisation tools with configurable DNS and QoS (DSCP) settings.
Utilities: Game Mode with Boost, Calm, Memory, Power and Timer options for a more controlled gaming setup.
Shake: Customisable mouse shaking with Left / Right and Up / Down directions, adjustable speed, intensity, ramp-up, randomness and automatic stop timer.
Shake: Independent Hold and Toggle activation modes with a dedicated hotkey, separate from the auto clicker.
Crosshair: Custom Roblox cursors with image importing, live previews and adjustable sizing.
Crosshair: Cursor and font preservation across Roblox updates, automatic original-file backups and reliable restoration. Supports Roblox, Bloxstrap and Fishstrap.
Macros: Record, edit and replay custom macros, with an emergency panic key (F12 by default) to stop everything instantly.
Presets: Save, share and instantly apply your entire configuration with one click.
Games: Launch supported games directly from the built-in games section.
Extras: Daily Spin Wheel with one free spin every 24 hours and a countdown displayed in the sidebar.
Extras: Discord authentication that remembers your account, synchronises with your selected theme and features a matching frosted-glass appearance.
Extras: Live news and patch notes panel that updates automatically while Surge Engine is running.

items.title: Welcome to Surge Engine
items.body: Welcome to Surge Engine! Stay up to date with the latest announcements, updates and features. Join our Discord community to get involved and never miss an update.
